افتعلتم (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْتُمْ (iftaʕaltum) /if.ta.ʕal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلْتُمْ (uftuʕiltum) /uf.tu.ʕil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
